description: This file defines the UserManager class for handling user authentication, account management, and encryption key operations within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for signup, login, password management, session handling, and encryption key retrieval.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: Manages user authentication, account updates, session control, and encryption keys for the Notesnook application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the user manager, fetching user data if available.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: authenticateEmail
methods.description: Authenticates a user via email to obtain a token.

methods.name: authenticateMultiFactorCode
methods.description: Completes MFA authentication with a code and method.

methods.name: authenticatePassword
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, handling fallback hashing if needed.

methods.name: _login
methods.description: Performs login with optional MFA code and method, sets user state.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves active user sessions.

methods.name: clearSessions
methods.description: Clears user sessions, optionally all sessions.

methods.name: activateTrial
methods.description: Activates a trial subscription.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, revoking tokens and resetting state.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores user data in key-value storage.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves stored user data.

methods.name: getLegacyUser
methods.description: Deprecated method to read user data from storage.

methods.name: resetUser
methods.description: Resets user data on the server.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user data on the server and local store.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes the user account after password verification.

methods.name: fetchUser
methods.description: Fetches user data from server and updates local store.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes user password.

methods.name: changeMarketingConsent
methods.description: Updates user's marketing consent preference.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password.

methods.name: getEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves user's encryption key and salt.

methods.name: getLegacyEncryptionKey
methods.description: Deprecated method to get legacy encryption key.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve or generate user-specific encryption keys.

methods.name: getAttachmentsKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the attachments encryption key.

methods.name: getMonographPasswordsKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the monograph passwords encryption key.

methods.name: getInboxKeys
methods.description: Retrieves or generates inbox encryption key pair.

methods.name: hasInboxKeys
methods.description: Checks if inbox keys are available.

methods.name: discardInboxKeys
methods.description: Removes inbox keys from user data.

methods.name: sendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends email verification to user.

methods.name: changeEmail
methods.description: Changes user's email address.

methods.name: recoverAccount
methods.description: Initiates account recovery process.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies if provided password matches stored credentials.

methods.name: _updatePassword
methods.description: Handles password change or reset process, including session clearing and key management.

methods.name: usesFallbackPWHash
methods.description: Checks if fallback password hash is used.
